      "event": "receive PREAUTH greeting",
      "action": "set state Authenticated",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },

      "event": "receive BYE greeting",
      "action": "set state Logout",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "NotAuthenticated",
      "event": "receive LOGIN or AUTHENTICATE",
      "action": "reply OK",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "NotAuthenticated",
      "event": "receive LOGOUT or shutdown",
      "action": "send BYE and OK",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive SELECT or EXAMINE",
      "action": "reply OK",
      "to": "Selected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive LOGOUT or shutdown",
      "action": "send BYE and OK",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "Selected",
      "event": "receive CLOSE or UNSELECT or failed SELECT",
      "action": "reply OK",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Selected",
      "event": "receive LOGOUT or shutdown",
      "action": "send BYE and OK",
      "to": "Logout"
    },

      "event": "connection closed",
      "action": "terminate",
      "to": "ConnectionClosed"
